text:
Maria Alvarez: Hey team — PR #34123 is blocked. CI saw a flaky heap-oom in linux-x64 smoke on shard-7, test name: TestMemoryPressure::AllocPathFail. Need one more reviewer and a CI rerun. Logs attached below.
Jon Park: Ack, can you repro locally?
Maria Alvarez: Tried on my dev laptop with local sharding, can't reproduce. It only failed in the CI container.
Alex Chen: @Maria do we have a core dump or heap profile from the runner? If not, rerun with DEBUG_HEAP=1 might help.
Maria Alvarez: No core yet. CI artifacts include a short trace, here's the relevant bit:
```
E 00:12:34 Alloc failing: requested 1.2GB, available 0.9GB
Stack: runtime/alloc.go:213 -> store/kv.go:520 -> test/heap_test.go:87
```
Sophie Patel: I can give this a quick review but won't be online for a couple hours. If it's a flaky infra issue maybe infra-oncall should look? @infra-oncall ping.
infra-oncall: Looking. Could be noisy scheduling on that runner class. Re-running on a different node type may help.
Alex Chen: We can do a targeted rerun for shard-7 only: `./ci rerun --pr 34123 --shard shard-7 --env linux-x64` — CI-bot will also preserve artifacts.
CI-bot: Rerun queued: https://ci.internal/runs/98321 (target: shard-7, env: linux-x64) :white_check_mark:
Jon Park: If the rerun flakes again, can we try a bisect across the last 3 commits? Might narrow down a memory-related regression.
Maria Alvarez: Good call. If rerun fails I'll trigger a bisect and drop the DEBUG_HEAP flag to collect heap profile. Also will add a short note in the PR description to avoid accidental merge.
Sophie Patel: Sounds good — I'll give the code a look later today and leave an approve if nothing suspicious.
Alex Chen: Optional mitigation: add a small test retry for this flaky case while we root-cause. Not ideal but buys time.
Maria Alvarez: Will avoid snapshot updates unless we confirm it's a true behavior change. Keeping test semantics intact for now.
infra-oncall: Rerun completed on alternative node. CI-bot: https://ci.internal/runs/98321/result -> success on rerun :tada:
Maria Alvarez: Nice — merging once I get one more reviewer approval. Thanks all for the quick help :heart: 
Jon Park: I'll give it a +1 after a quick read, dropping a review now.
CI-bot: Merge queued after approvals.
